decision_rules: If backendoutput or clientreceive cadence is below60fps,locate WCcopy or wait/RTT stall first;keep exact pixels and same SPS while changing one measured cost.
If actual client/RDD output keeps60fps but sinkdrops persist,inspect PTS/media-clock alignment and RDD/VideoSink wakeups;avoid blindly increasing queue or VEclock.
If frame ready ahead of media deadline and compositor drops grow,investigate upload/presentation side;currentv28 evidence had mostly VideoSink drops,so this is conditional.

If WCcopy remains dominant,use existing cedar_wc_copy_bench only on an alreadyidle stable authorized buffer;ordinaryRAM selftest cannot prove WC bandwidth. No newDMA allocation/import or browser hardware handle.
